audit_metadata.title: Pre-Train Defensive Security & MLOps Architectural Audit (pre-train_audit)
audit_metadata.lead_auditor: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer, Enterprise Security Architect & Technical Project Manager
frameworks: Cloudflare Defensive Security Audit Skill Suite
audit_metadata.phase_assessed: Pre-Training Cloud MLOps & Sovereign Bridge (Track 1: QLoRA SLM & Track 2: 2-Phase Whisper Dual-Head Spoof Classifier)

nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: All training corpora (100k smishing corpus, 20k audio benchmark) are 100% synthetic/open-source with zero Class B citizen PII; cloud training on Google Colab utilizes report_to='none', preventing telemetry or loss exfiltration to third-party MLOps trackers (WandB/Comet); runtime model inference remains 100% sovereign within local containers (hares-slm and hares-worker-media)

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_class_b_segregation.verification: Inspection of uae_smishing_100k.jsonl and uae_smishing_25k_core.jsonl confirms zero phone numbers or real citizen identities; prompt envelopes encapsulate threat indicators inside <citizen_forwarded_text> XML tags with case-insensitive boundary scrubbing (AUDIT-OBS-17)

fr_1_1_unified_whisper_dual_head.verification: Unified Whisper feature extraction decoupled into 2-phase pipeline (Phase 1 pre-extracts 20,000 x 768 matrix once; Phase 2 trains WhisperDeepfakeMLPHead in <60s on T4 GPU); forward pass supports both 3D unpooled tensors and 2D pre-pooled batches without breaking 2D sequence pooling (1, 1)

fr_1_3_whatsapp_opus_resilience.verification: Training pipeline trains spoof classifier directly on genuine and synthetic WhatsApp 16 kHz mono Opus (.ogg) audio files, matching real-world WhatsApp compression profiles (16-24 kbps VBR)

fr_1_4_nfr_3_1_conformal_calibration.verification: Phase 3 computes non-parametric empirical conformal quantiles on n >= 3,000 genuine UAE voice notes with alpha = 0.001, mathematically bounding False Positive Rate <= 0.1% at 95% statistical confidence

fr_2_4_nfr_1_3_guided_json_decoding.verification: SLM training targets enforce exact JSON compliance to TextTriageInferenceResult with strict binary keys (is_impersonation, urgency_or_coercion, financial_or_credential_demand) and confidence scores in [0.0, 1.0]

hardware_t4_float16_guard.verification: setup_bitsandbytes_config() checks torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() and forces torch.float16 on Turing CC 7.5 GPUs, eliminating 3-5x software emulation slowdowns

checkpoint_streaming_and_resumption.verification: TrainingArguments configured with save_steps=500, save_total_limit=3, and resume_from_checkpoint=True targeting Google Drive (/content/drive/MyDrive/hares_mlops/checkpoints/slm/)

host_ram_oom_mitigation.verification: merge_lora_to_fp16() unloads previous models, triggers gc.collect(), empties CUDA cache, and loads with device_map='cpu' and low_cpu_mem_usage=True to protect Colab 12.7 GB system RAM

dual_model_quantization_export.verification: Exporter produces both 4-bit AutoAWQ (for vLLM container) and llama.cpp GGUF Q4_K_M (for edge serving) in dedicated, separate directories

AUDIT-OBS-17.title: Case-Insensitive Regex XML Boundary Tag Stripping in SLM
AUDIT-OBS-17.verification: LocalSLMClient and ChatML training formatting strictly enforce case-insensitive stripping of </citizen_forwarded_text>

AUDIT-OBS-18.title: Enforce weights_only=True on PyTorch Model Deserialization
AUDIT-OBS-18.verification: weights_only=True enforced in train_whisper_dual_head.py, colab_whisper_dual_head_training.ipynb, verify_colab_artifacts.py, and audio_pipeline.py

AUDIT-OBS-19.title: Subprocess Environment Sanitization Stripping Sensitive Secrets
AUDIT-OBS-19.verification: AudioPreprocessor passes sanitized environment allowlist (PATH, SYSTEMROOT) stripping DB URIs and API tokens from child FFmpeg media processes

AUDIT-OBS-20.title: Strict Finite Value and Range Validation on Conformal Calibration Scores
AUDIT-OBS-20.verification: ConformalCalibrator strictly validates math.isfinite(s) and 0.0 <= s <= 1.0, filtering out NaN/Inf corruptions

new_pretrain_audit_observations.title: Unrestricted trust_remote_code=True in Hugging Face Model & Tokenizer Loaders
new_pretrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained and AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained explicitly pass trust_remote_code=True without repository revision pinning. Because transformers >= 4.45 natively supports Qwen2 architectures, enabling trust_remote_code introduces supply-chain risk if an untrusted model identifier or malicious adapter is supplied.
new_pretrain_audit_observations.remediation: Default trust_remote_code to False for standard architectures. For custom models, require explicit opt-in and pin commit revisions (e.g., revision='<sha>').

new_pretrain_audit_observations.title: Unfiltered tarfile.extractall() in Colab Audio Benchmark Unpacker
new_pretrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: Cell 3 uses tar.extractall('/content/') without setting filter='data' (PEP 706) or verifying tarinfo member path components against parent directory traversal (CVE-2007-4559 pattern).
new_pretrain_audit_observations.remediation: Specify filter='data' when using Python 3.12+, or iterate tar.getmembers() validating that member paths resolve strictly inside the target destination before extraction.

new_pretrain_audit_observations.title: Defensive Finite-Value Validation in Training Conformal Quantile Computation
new_pretrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: In run_conformal_calibration_phase3(), non_conformity_scores are sorted directly from synthetic_prob.tolist() without filtering math.isnan(s) or math.isinf(s). While ConformalCalibrator guards this upon runtime ingestion (AUDIT-OBS-20), the training script should defensively filter NaNs before writing the calibration profile.
new_pretrain_audit_observations.remediation: Apply [float(s) for s in scores if math.isfinite(s) and 0.0 <= s <= 1.0] before computing sorted quantiles and serializing to JSON.

new_pretrain_audit_observations.title: Ambient Environment Scrubbing in Quantization Subprocesses
new_pretrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: In export_gguf_quantization(), subprocess.run invokes llama-quantize and convert_hf_to_gguf.py inheriting ambient process environment variables. In shared or staging environments, inherited API tokens (e.g., HF_TOKEN, WANDB_API_KEY) could be exposed to crash dumps.
new_pretrain_audit_observations.remediation: Pass an explicit sanitized environment dictionary containing only PATH and SYSTEMROOT, identical to AudioPreprocessor._get_sanitized_subprocess_env() (AUDIT-OBS-19).

new_pretrain_audit_observations.title: Cryptographic Checksum Verification of Input Dataset Packages
new_pretrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: package_colab_data.py generates SHA-256 digests in colab_package_manifest.json. verify_colab_artifacts.py currently verifies downloaded model weights but does not verify dataset archive hashes prior to training synchronization.
new_pretrain_audit_observations.remediation: Add an optional --verify-packages flag to verify_colab_artifacts.py to assert SHA-256 digests against colab_package_manifest.json before training.
